changelog:
**Expanded triggers and improved setup logic.**

- Added new natural language triggers such as "contact enrichment", "linkedin enrichment", and "pull the whole biography" to support broader use cases.
- Improved setup script to avoid double-counting sessions when Cargo GTM plugin is installed.
- Streamlined documentation for asking users to star the repository, including explicit user consent instructions.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
summary: Turn a LinkedIn profile URL into a full person profile plus a verified work email in a single call, powered by Cargo. Triggers: "enrich these LinkedIn profiles", "get details from this LinkedIn URL", "I have LinkedIn URLs and need emails", "enrich LinkedIn data", "who is this person", "contact enrichment", "linkedin enrichment", "get their headline and tenure", "pull the whole biography". Providers: aiArk. Skip when: you do not have the LinkedIn URL yet — use find-linkedin-url first; or you only have a name and domain — use find-work-email.
